description: one crocodile, our base 'Crocodile' templated on BM&V's Alligator base 0BCB00:Black Marsh.esm at a fixed level, in the shallows east of the scaffold on the landing (dock5, cell 0D77AF at -9,15, which has navmesh 1FAEB6), fixed band 1, under an enable parent (ref.lq25.beast) that LQ25's first stage turns on, with the offal and the crew's bait bucket (thing.lq25.bait) by the pilings under the same parent

BM&V's two villagers north along the shore from the ship's door, the man 08D5EE (-10,15) and the woman 08D5EF (-9,15), become the baiting crew, two Agaceph rafters, Okan-Zish and Wuleen-Taza; each is given a base of their own, templated on the shared one (00FF4D 'Villager', 02A1EE; the Talk names shape), and named so; the shared bases are never edited. Their rival is BM&V's own Boat Captain 08D5F1 (-9,19), unchanged, who speaks as Sells-Dear through a reference alias on 08D5F1

one viper (BM&V's Viper base 17BC83:Black Marsh.esm, which BM&V places in the basin) on the dry ground of cell 0D7883 (-5,18, navmesh, no NPCs) where the youth stands, fixed band, under an enable parent (ref.lq30.beast) that LQ30's first stage turns on

the way east from the road along row 18 into the basin, BM&V's own terrain (no statics added), to the dry ground in cell 0D7883 (-5,18, which has navmesh 1FAE4C; 0D7885 east of it has none) where Sei-Wan and the viper stand, off the marsh way MQ05 uses between the landing and the road; zone.lq30.gate at the road

Sei-Wan, a young Argonian, on dry ground in the basin (cell 0D7883) and Haj-Wan, the youth's kin, by the road, each a W-npc from a BM&V Argonian villager template; at either ending the youth is moved to mark.lq30.gate by the road, once the player has left 0D7883

Buys-The-Months, the debt-labour broker, standing on the deck of his ship, moored below Hereguard Plantation, west of Lilmoth (5350,-7800, Dock1's navmesh 079823), the one way off the ship, with no enable parent; his one package is the force-greet of MQ01's topic.mq01-not-on-roll, gated on MQ01 stage 10, with a greet radius that keeps him on the deck

three of the broker's Owing gang standing in the ship's hold on its navmeshed floor, one standing place each and no package: Wuleen-Sei, the broker's overseer; Ux-Xeek, his port hand; Dives-Without-A-Rope, washed out from years away from Nine Bends (MQ01, MQ03)
the hold cell's location is cleared of vanilla Skyrim's 'Dainty Sload' (07B91A:Skyrim.esm), so no Skyrim name shows in the hold
Valenwood.esp's start-game quests 0MainQuest1 and AANEWQuestM (0F0F3E) do not start until the player first enters Valenwood, so nothing of theirs reaches a Black Marsh opening
BM&V's greeting quest 01Captain ('Welcome to Black Marsh') does not start until MQ03 ends
a persistent start marker in the hold of the broker's ship; ARG_Opening points at it instead of the pier marker, so a new game opens there (character creation in the hold)

the house's outer door 0FE95A (a Riften model) and its inner side 0FE832 (a Whiterun model) take the base of BM&V's own Lilmoth house doors, so no Nordic model reaches the player through a door a quest sends them to (0006); never locked
Salts-The-Catch standing inside the door of her house and Nesh-Deeka standing at the far end of its room, on the house's navmeshed floor, one standing place each (MQ01, MQ03)

in the ship's hold, on its floor at the far side of the hold from Dives-Without-A-Rope's standing place, under an enable parent off at the start that MQ01's ending (the join line, spoken in Salts-The-Catch's house, another interior) switches on: a lockbox (vanilla's lockbox base 09424C:Skyrim.esm, the jar put in it by the builder) she owns, locked (Novice), holding one quest item, the cutters' jar of Hist sap (BM&V's own small jar model); its key in her inventory; five lockpicks, not owned, on the floor beside it (MQ03)

the two cell men, Hides-His-Wake and Counts-The-Jars (npc rows cell-man-1 and -2, the knotted cord at the wrist, fixed level, band 2), standing hostile from the start at the giant tree's roots past the leech water north of the village, cell 039793:Black Marsh.esm (about 91400,-5300 and 90900,-4900, out of sight of the village's north huts), on BM&V's navmesh; nothing else is placed there and nothing switches them

Jars of Hist Sap (thing.mq04.sap-jars, a quest item on the model of BM&V's clay jar 08AB9C) lying on the ground at the giant tree's roots beside the cell men (about 91150,-5100, cell 039793); a lockbox (vanilla base 09424C:Skyrim.esm, locked Novice, owned by Pays-Late, no key placed) on the bank at Pays-Late's feet holding Pays-Late's Gum Pot (thing.mq04.gum-pot, a quest item on the model of BM&V's clay pot 1C40C2)
the Village named from the lore's Murkmire villages

three standing in one place each for the whole quest, no package: the root-herald Hires-By-The-Season on the bare ground by the first house (near 084A84), the tree-minder Pays-Late on the bank under the stilts (near 084A7B), the egg-tender Turns-The-Clutch by the egg pool (near 084A87); Pays-Late's gum box is we.mq04.items; the cell men are we.mq04.cell

Kaska-Meen, a tree-minder of the interior, and Ei-Tuja, a travelling Nisswo, standing in one place each for the whole quest on BM&V's ground among the trees by the stone towers (cell 0D78C1, about -29700,79100 and -29300,78400, near the soldier 08D5E9); no package; both band 0

one door pair inside the ship (01Ship) joining its two sections: the cell's one navmesh (0AA666, 353 triangles, one component, x 2382..3478, z 6685..7283) reaches Lilmoth's door 0AA837 (48 units) but no triangle lies within 2954 units of the landing door 23D496 (x 6038, y 5825, z 8054), whose section (with 23D688) has no navmesh; door A at the navmesh's east end by triangle 335 (about x 3295, y 5343, z 7071), door B beside 23D496 (about x 5990, y 5825, z 8054), both doors take BM&V's own Argonian door base (1DE5DF, 01loaddoorArg), exact spots measured at build

two of BM&V's own Giant Wasps (base 166381) standing hostile from the start at a bend of the marsh way between the landing and the paved road (cell 0D776B, about -36500,60500 and -36200,60300, about 9,000 units up from the landing and 19,000 from the grove), fixed level at band 1, no enable parent; the way itself is BM&V's terrain (root and shallows)
'Docks' named Soulrest: a port on the 01Ship coast line
Bent-Spine (npc.mercantile-coast.lilmoth-divers-yard.night-reed-fence) standing in the Chapter's inner room of the cleared dungeon from the start (quest.tg.tg01 placements)
Sits-By-The-Water (npc.mercantile-coast.soulrest.tg01-friend), the thief's drinking friend, standing beside him on the shore by the houses from the start
Tilts-The-Jug, the Chapter's teetotal desk at Soulrest, inside the house
BM&V's cell 'Pussbottom' named Pusbottom

Keeps-What-Floats (npc.mercantile-coast.soulrest.tg01-thief), a cowardly dock thief standing on the shore by the houses from the start, and his strongbox (lock Novice, his key) on the bare ground by the houses at the water's edge holding the Blue Jasper Necklace (item.tg01.jasper-necklace), the strongbox switched on by TG01's stage 20 (quest.tg.tg01 placements)
S'Tabi (npc.mercantile-coast.soulrest.khajiit-caravan-factor), a Khajiit trader standing beside the house door, who sells to the Chapter and sends people to Tilts-The-Jug

three clients of a drowned merchant on the south bank of the deep water east of Lilmoth, a short walk from the trapdoor 16BF7F: Neeta-Haj (npc.mercantile-coast.lilmoth.tg02-clutch-client), Okan-Tei (npc.mercantile-coast.lilmoth.tg02-charm-client) and Dar-Zeel (npc.mercantile-coast.lilmoth.tg02-beads-client), switched on by TG02's stage 20 with the merchant's lockbox (lock Novice) on the floor of the deep water
